bugs.description: Code observation (label vs specification, verified by run): the Table 1 texreg call hard-codes the row 'Year Fixed Effects' = Yes for all four models, but the four Table 1 models (lines 356, 365, 374, 384) enter `year` as a numeric column, i.e. one linear year slope, not year fixed effects. Other models in the same script and all Table 2 models use as.factor(year).
bugs.evidence: outputs/fixef_all_cycle_AE_fit2.csv has year-related fixed-effect terms ['year'] (a single slope). Refitting with as.factor(year) (R_c, outputs/robustness_bc.csv) moves T1 from 0.01827 to 0.01741; both round to 0.02 with p < 0.001, so the printed Table 1 is what the deposited code produces and the conclusion is unchanged.
